exceptions.reason: Development-time lint plugin. It is executed as a separate tool and no part of it is linked into or distributed with this project's output, so the LGPL's linking obligations are not triggered.

Transitive build-time dependency of Vitest, plus whichever of its platform binaries pnpm installs on the current machine. MPL-2.0 is file-level copyleft and the source is unmodified, so redistribution obligations do not extend to this project's own files. The trailing * is deliberate: naming one exact binary would make this exception both incomplete and stale on every platform other than the one it was written on.
Browser support data set, not code. CC-BY-4.0 requires attribution only, which the package's own metadata carries.
